summary: Tested Requisiciones + role-based bell notifications, money hiding for trabajador, plain-language nav and role filtering, the arc-reactor Jarvis icon, the mobile bottom nav and 'Más' sheet, horizontal scroll on Kanban and Equipo, and regression flows. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass. Frontend: every requested flow passed on desktop 1920, mobile 390 and tablet 800. No critical bugs. Found a few minor issues, some of them older than this change.

minor.issue: This bug was already in the code before this change. routes_misc.all_orders() runs db.orders.find({}) with no filter on is_archived. DELETE /orders/{id} only soft-archives (is_archived=True). Archived or deleted orders are still counted in dashboard stats, revenue charts and sales totals, and they show up in the /api/production Taller lists. Seen in the app: after an order was archived, the dashboard showed 'Pedidos activos 1' while GET /api/orders returned 0.

This was already in the code before this change. Self-registration with departamento='Ventas' automatically gives role 'ventas', so anyone can get access to money data. Consider making new accounts 'trabajador' until an admin promotes them.
There is no DELETE endpoint for requisitions. Test data had to be removed directly in Mongo by id.

ui_bugs.issue: At desktop 1920 the form column is narrow (lg:col-span-2) and uses sm:grid-cols-3, so the 'Herramientas' chip label is cut off ('Herramien'). 'Insumos de taller' wraps onto 2 lines.

integration_issues.issue: Requisiciones.jsx loads the list only on mount. If a staff user is already on the page and a new requisition notification opens /requisiciones/<new id>, the dialog opens but the card is not in the list until a reload. The inbox also only polls every 30s.

issues: The 'Guardar costo' button wraps onto 2 lines next to the cost input. Add whitespace-nowrap.
Dates use the browser's native datetime-local picker, which does not match the dark theme. This was there before this change.
There is no data-testid on the FAB.

action_items: Exclude is_archived orders in routes_misc.all_orders() (used by stats, charts, production and sales summary)
Fix the 'Herramientas' chip text overflow in the RequisitionForm category grid (use grid-cols-2 at lg or allow wrapping)
Reload the requisition list in Requisiciones.jsx when the :id param changes, so the newly opened requisition appears
Optional: do not auto-give the 'ventas' role on self-registration; add whitespace-nowrap to 'Guardar costo'; add a data-testid to the FAB
critical_code_review_comments: routes_requisitions.notify_staff runs through asyncio.create_task with no reference kept. It works, but the task can be garbage-collected or lost if the server shuts down. Consider BackgroundTasks.
update_requisition calls req_or_404 twice. That is fine, but the PATCH has no check that the requisition actually changed state.

hide_money is applied correctly to /orders list, PATCH /orders, POST notas and /production. The PDF has its own is_staff gate. Client profile and the archive are STAFF-only. Requisition costo is removed for non-staff.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (one LOW layout issue)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ orders (TEST_UI Cliente, TEST_UI Regresion), the TEST_UI Lima fina requisition plus its inbox entries, and pytest TEST_ requisitions and orders. All were hard-deleted by id afterwards. Side effect on existing data: the ventas inbox notification for the existing 'Zirconias 3mm' requisition was marked read by the read-all test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). Run tests/test_iter7_requisitions_notifications.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001. DB had 0 orders initially, so the tests create their own TEST order and clean up by id directly in Mongo (DELETE /orders only archives). maria's user id is d44ee174-dfd6-4944-9f9a-382fa1cc1447. Valid stages: Ventas, Diseño 3D, Ceras, ... Web push was not verified (no VAPID keys).
